segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily-T-zone skin report mixed results: some see breakouts controlled and texture smoothed with regular use, while others (including one who used it after a same-brand water-based serum by mistake) report worsened oiliness and breakouts from the oil format.
segments.dry: Reviewers describing dry or combination-dry skin report the oil does not dry out or flake their skin and leaves it feeling soft and hydrated, though one combination-to-dry reviewer had a breakout after a second use.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers generally report clearer skin, reduced breakouts around hormonal cycles, and a non-drying feel, with one calling it their favorite retinol for combo/oily skin and one noting it replaced their moisturizer.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are the most divided: several say this is the first retinol that does not burn, dry, or irritate their skin and even calms acne, while others report burning, rashes, or breakouts, especially if too much product is used.
segments.mature: Mature-skin and midlife reviewers (40s-70s) report the product calms cystic acne and helps with fine lines simultaneously, with one 72-year-old and one perimenopausal reviewer specifically praising results on long-standing cystic acne.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers report visible improvement in fine lines, firmness, or plumping alongside acne benefits; one mature reviewer felt the oil aged her skin overnight, an isolated dissenting account.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers state the oil moisturizes well and does not dry out their skin, with some skipping moisturizer entirely; a minority still found the oil-based texture too heavy or occlusive for their skin.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with inflamed or cystic acne report reduced redness and inflammation overnight; one review specifically links less bumpiness and redness to nightly use.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the product as gentle enough not to cause the flaking, peeling, or irritation typical of other retinols, though some experienced burning or purging-related irritation when overused.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report faster fading of dark marks, hyperpigmentation, and old acne scarring with continued use, including a person of color noting hyperpigmentation improvement after three months.
concerns.blemishes: The majority of reviewers, across ages and skin types, report fewer and faster-clearing breakouts, less cystic acne, and quicker recovery from active pimples; a notable minority (about seven reviewers) report new or worsened breakouts, especially early in use or with higher drop counts.
concerns.oiliness: A few reviewers with oily skin state the product did not increase oiliness and left skin balanced, while others with oily or acne-prone skin specifically blame the oil format for increased breakouts and no reduction in oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Long-lasting bottle, good value over time
Leaves skin soft without added moisturizer

extraits.texte: I wanted to love this product based on reviews but it just wasn't for me. I've been dealing with hormonal acne but it just wasn't the miracle product for me like it was for others. If felt great in my skin and made my face very soft but the oils were too much for my skin type and caused more breakouts. The smell is very sunflower heavy, not the best smelling product I've used. For the hefty price tag the packaging is awful. The bottle leaks and the dropper doesn't work properly. Overall I was very dissatisfied with it and returned it to try another brand of retinol.

First night I used it I woke up and my skin looked and felt amazing. I tried again the second night and woke up with 4 zits on face! I'm 49 and have combination to dry skin. This might work for some, but not for my sensitive skin.

I struggle with deep cystic acne and am prone to millia. Pro and con is that this product WILL purge deep congestion. It works but is intense! I have been using this 2-3xs a week, taking breaks when too much flaking or irritation occurs, for almost 3 months. Milia is nearly gone by this point. At time it almost falls out without any manual extraction required. Its been a rough go dealing with cycles of purging but is improving and results are noticable. Flaking and irritation come with the territory and I think lighter surface acne has occurred since this is oil based. Its not perfect but does a good job pushing out sebum and knots of protein. The product is silky and feels great. Smell is light and medicinal. May not be for everyone but great if you like an herbal scent. Only 4 stars as it helps with some problems but creates new ones. Worth a shot if you have deep acne. I will continue to use and keep in my arsenal.

I have sensitive skin with an oily T-Zone, prone to breakouts on chin and cheeks. During the first two weeks of use I experienced unusual breakouts because the retinol speeds up cell turn over. If this happens to you, stick with it! My pores have significantly improved, less buildup, smaller appearance. I use this every night and find the oils hydrating enough to not need to moisturise on top of it. In the morning I use a hyaluronic or vitamin c serum then Intensive Moisture Balance or Skin Smoothing moisturiser, followed by sun screen. This oil has been great for my adult acne and plumping my skin. I wish that the percentage of retinol was given and that better instructions for use were given. I think a lot of people are unsure if they can put a moisturiser on top.

I am not much of a review writer, but this thing is amazing. I only started having acne in my twenties. By 2014 it was pretty bad and I was prescribed antibiotics. It got much better and I would only get an occasional pimple. Recently, though, maybe two months ago, my skin started freaaaaking out. I have very sensitive and dry skin. It was a disaster. None of my usual remedies helped. Niacimide, zinc, pimple patches. Nada. Plus, all the previous zits were red and inflamed days and days after, as if nothing was healing. I bought this in a moment of slight despair. It is amazing. I am four nights in, but my entire face calmed down. As little as two nights later, everything was better, getting under control, clearing out. I was worried I would purge and it would be worse, since I only rarely use retinol, but it was very gentle.

I developed adult acne (hormonal acne) and I've used the Retinol oil 1-2 times weekly for several years. I have very sensitive skin and as long as I don't use too much product, my skin likes it. If I use a little too much oil, it can burn my skin as well as cause breakouts. I found a balance that works for my skin, and it's a nice routine a couple nights a week. It leaves my skin feeling incredibly soft and fairly pimple free.

extraits.titre: This product completely changed my skin for the better!!
extraits.texte: As a Certified Skin Specialist & a person who has always struggled with sensitive + acne prone skin, I cannot say enough good things about this retinol! It is hard for me to find a product that doesn't dry out & sensitize my skin, but also treats my breakouts. That was until I found this product! Within 3 months my ance has been maintained by at least 75% & I'm starting to see HUGE differences in my hyperpigmentation which is super important as a POC. Definitely a must-try for anyone with breakout-prone skin!!!
